Description: A fungal infection, or mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus.
An allergy is an immune system response to a foreign substance not harmful to most people.
Gastroesophageal reflux disease is a chronic digestive disease.
Cholestasis is a condition where bile cannot flow from the liver to the duodenum.
An adverse drug reaction is an injury caused by taking medication.
Peptic ulcers are open sores on the inner lining of the stomach.
AIDS is a chronic, potentially life-threatening condition caused by HIV.
Diabetes is a disease that occurs when blood glucose is too high.
Gastroenteritis is an intestinal infection with diarrhea, cramps, nausea, vomiting, and fever.
Asthma is a condition in which airways narrow and swell causing breathing difficulty.
Hypertension is a long-term medical condition where blood pressure is persistently elevated.
A migraine is a headache that can cause severe throbbing pain or pulsing sensation.
Cervical spondylosis is age-related wear affecting the spinal disks in your neck.
Paralysis from brain hemorrhage where bleeding occurs inside the skull.
Jaundice is a condition producing yellowing of skin and whites of the eyes.
Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease affecting humans and other animals.
Chickenpox is a highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy, blister-like rash.
Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne tropical disease caused by the dengue virus.
Typhoid fever is a bacterial infection due to Salmonella typhi.
Hepatitis A is a highly contagious liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus.
Hepatitis B is a serious liver infection caused by the hepatitis B virus.
Hepatitis C is a viral infection that causes liver inflammation.
Hepatitis D is a serious liver disease caused by infection with the hepatitis D virus.
Hepatitis E is a liver disease caused by the hepatitis E virus.
Alcoholic hepatitis is inflammation of the liver caused by drinking alcohol.
Tuberculosis is a potentially serious infectious disease mainly affecting the lungs.
The common cold is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract.
Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs.
Hemorrhoids are swollen veins in the lower rectum and anus.
A heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked.
Varicose veins are gnarled, enlarged veins close to the skin surface.
Hypothyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland does not produce enough hormones.
Hyperthyroidism occurs when the thyroid gland produces too much thyroid hormone.
Hypoglycemia is an abnormally low level of blood sugar.
Osteoarthritis is the most common form of arthritis affecting joint cartilage.
Arthritis is inflammation of one or more joints causing pain and stiffness.
BPPV causes intense, brief dizziness episodes.
Acne is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become clogged.
A UTI is an infection in any part of the urinary system.
Psoriasis is a skin disease that causes red, itchy scaly patches.
Impetigo is a common and highly contagious skin infection.
